mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a warm and clear 79 degrees, which feels like 84, over near Badger Ridge Middle School. The night sky features a lovely waxing crescent moon, though there will be no visible International Space Station passes tonight.

In city news, Verona is promoting sustainability on multiple fronts. Apartment residents can drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is offering rain barrel and toilet rebate programs, plus giving out free property contour maps to help residents build their own yard rain gardens.

We have some wonderful events on the horizon. This Saturday, July 18th, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Capitol Square or enjoy the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Closer to home, mark your calendars for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market returning to Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July 22nd.
In the weekly police report, on Tuesday, July 7th, officers arrested a 24-year-old Verona woman on an outstanding warrant and cited her for drug offenses after finding her on North Jefferson Street.

If you are craving Culver's, the local spot is currently closed and will reopen at 10:00 AM tomorrow. While we missed out on today's Snickers Swirl, you can look forward to enjoying tomorrow's refreshing Mint Cookie flavor of the day as soon as they open.
